note: Date of service, per page. (1) Key/value: the DOS dates the extractor accepted (staging/extraction.json), never a print key's, grouped by their tier; the page takes the first group in kv_priority for its kind (page classification L1, page_kinds) and within it the highest score; weak dates need a score above weak_min_score; a discharge page pairs Admit (From) with Discharge (To). (2) Only when key/value has no date, a label below that starts within the first or last edge_words words of the page, with a date right after it (within label_reach_chars, only label_gap_words words between, so 'Visit Date: | DOB: 01/02/1960' is not a DOS; never a date after D:, T:, DD:, DT:, TD:, TT:, Dictated or Transcribed) — an encounter label wins, else admit is From and discharge To. (3) Other pages only: the dictated date, else the transcribed one. Otherwise no date. Edit labels here, not in dos_logic.py. Reloads on change.
note_default: DOS_DEFAULT_DATE is shown for a page with no date of its own (doc-level columns, review-ui downloads). It is never a page's Extracted DOS; it is the Final DOS of a stand-alone non-visit document (continuity_canon.json default_final_dos).
note_non_visit: DOS_NON_VISIT_DATE is the Final DOS of a stand-alone non-visit document: Demographics, Patient Information, Problem List, Immunizations ... (continuity_canon.json default_final_dos). Set apart from DOS_DEFAULT_DATE (a page with no date) on 2026-10-27 (user). Each page's Extracted DOS is untouched; review-ui shows it beside the Final as (E: date).
note_confidence: 2026-10-25 (user: one scale, never fixed; stages/lib/confidence.py, keyword-canon/confidence_canon.json): how strongly each source backs a date. A key/value date the model scored: the model's score lifted by the rules' score (x conflict 0.8 when another date of its priority group scores within 80% of it). kv: a key/value date with no score at all (staging from before the model ran), x no_model. edge: an edge-label date the key/value extractor did not read, x no_model (0.68: passable). dictation: a dictated / transcribed date, x no_model x fallback (0.26: flagged). No date: no confidence.
note_weak_min_score: A weak key's date (weak, weak_last: Date, Report Date, Service, dt, dd, ...) is a candidate only when its score (the model's, else the rules') is above this. No other tier has a floor: any score counts, and the score only orders dates within a group.
note_page_kinds: A page's kind is its page classification L1 (page_subtype stage, before DOS; a row without axes gives its page_type): these names make it discharge or lab; any other, or no classification, is other.
note_kv_priority: Which key/value date a page takes. Candidates are the DOS dates the extractor accepted (staging/extraction.json), grouped by the tier it gave them; a print key's date (tier printed) is never one, and a tier not listed for the page's kind is not one either. Discharge: the Admit / Discharge pair (From = admit, To = the discharge on or after it, one alone is both; an edge label fills a missing side), then Date of Service, then weak keys. Lab: Collected, then Received, then Report Date (report), then Date of Service, then weak. Other: Date of Service, then weak. Lab and other pages end with the Admit / Discharge pair, so a discharge page the classifier missed keeps its stay. weak_last = a weak key in weak_last_keys (dt, dd), after every other weak key; keyless = a date in the header / footer band with no key in front of it. Within a group the highest score wins (the model's, else the rules', then page order); a weak key's date (Report Date too) needs a score above weak_min_score. Only when no group has a date: the edge keyword, then (other pages) the dictated date.
note_exam_keys: 2026-11-01 (user): an exam date (a study's date quoted on a note) is a priority group of its own, 'exam': last on Progress Note and discharge pages, with service on lab and other pages.
note_amended: 2026-11-01 (user): a date with one of amended_words within amended_reach_chars before it (on its line) is when the note was amended, never the DOS: dropped from the key/value dates, the edge labels, the keyword pass and the dictated date; the next option is used.
note_report_as_discharge: 2026-11-01 (user): a discharge page with an admit date and no discharge date takes its Report Date (on or after the admit date) as the discharge date.
note_keyword_pass: 2026-11-01 (user): on a discharge or Progress Note page the label step reads a DOS label anywhere on the page (other pages: the first / last edge_words words); with still no date, the keyword pass takes its weak key/value dates under weak_min_score.
note_signature: 2026-11-01 (user): when a page has no DOS, or one under signature_fallback_below, and kv_extract read an electronic signature with a date, the last signature's date (the main doctor's) is the DOS.
note_neighbours: 2026-11-01 (user): dates are kept consistent across pages. A page (not lab) with no DOS, one under neighbours.below, or a fallback DOS (keyword pass, signature, dictation): when the sure dated pages within max_gap before and after agree on one date it takes that date (confidence = the weaker neighbour's x factor); otherwise a date of its own outside the neighbours' dates is dropped (no DOS rather than a stray one).
